enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in his own room, keeping the room dark and quiet with the fan off.
enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on the bed in Bedroom 1. Closes his eyes. Remains asleep. Keeps the room light switched off. Leaves the fan switched off. Stays in bed without getting up until 06:45.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing, following his usual morning routine step by step.
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up on the edge of the bed. Stands up. Walks from Bedroom 1 to the Bathroom. Opens the bathroom door. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the tap. Washes his face with water. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brushes his teeth. Rinses his mouth. Puts the toothbrush back. Turns on the shower. Steps into the shower. Washes his body with soap. Turns off the shower. Steps out. Picks up the towel. Wipes his body dry. Wipes his hair. Hangs the towel back. Turns off the tap. Turns off the bathroom light. Opens the door. Walks out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a flexitarian breakfast of toast, fruit and tea, then rinsing his plate.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Kitchen. Turns on the kitchen light. Picks up the bread. Places two slices into the toaster. Presses the toaster lever down. Picks up the kettle. Fills the kettle with water at the sink. Places the kettle on its base. Presses the kettle switch on. Opens the refrigerator. Takes out fruit. Closes the refrigerator. Places the fruit on the counter. Picks up a knife. Cuts the fruit. Places the fruit pieces onto a plate. Waits for the toaster. Picks up the toast when it pops up. Places the toast on the plate. Pours hot water from the kettle into a mug. Drops a tea bag into the mug. Picks up the plate and the mug. Sits down at the kitchen table. Eats the toast and fruit. Drinks the tea. Stands up. Carries the plate and mug to the sink. Rinses the plate under the tap. Places the plate on the drying rack. Turns off the tap. Says 'morning' to Member 2 as she enters the Kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing his written weekly budget notes and checking reminder alerts on his phone before starting study.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen to Bedroom 1. Opens the bedroom door. Walks to the desk. Sits down on the chair. Picks up his written weekly budget notes from the desk. Reads the notes. Turns the pages. Places the notes back on the desk. Picks up his phone. Presses the phone button. Unlocks the phone. Looks at the reminder alerts on the screen. Scrolls through the alerts. Presses the screen to dismiss the alerts. Places the phone back on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up his desk lamp, computer and monitor and logging into the Monash online learning platform for the lockdown study day.
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up the desk lamp. Places it on the desk. Presses the desk lamp switch on. Adjusts the lamp arm. Picks up the computer. Places it on the desk. Opens the laptop lid. Presses the power button. Picks up the monitor. Stands it on the desk. Presses the monitor power button. Picks up the monitor cable. Plugs the cable into the computer. Picks up the keyboard. Places it in front of the monitor. Picks up the mouse. Places it beside the keyboard. Sits down on the chair. Types his username on the keyboard. Types his password. Presses the Enter key. Opens the browser. Types the Monash online learning platform address. Presses Enter. Clicks the login button. Waits for the page to load.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending a live online Master of Social Work lecture and taking detailed written notes.
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at the desk facing the monitor. Clicks the join button for the live lecture. Puts on his headphones. Picks up his pen. Opens his notebook to a blank page. Writes the lecture title at the top of the page. Watches the lecture slides on the monitor. Writes notes on the page. Underlines key points. Turns the page. Continues writing notes. Pauses the pen when the lecturer shows a diagram. Copies the diagram into the notebook. Writes more notes. Presses the mute button when not speaking. Types a short question into the chat box. Presses Enter to send it. Writes the lecturer's answer in the notebook. Continues writing until the lecture ends. Clicks the leave button.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle and making a cup of tea for a short study break.
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the chair. Walks from Bedroom 1 to the Kitchen. Picks up the kettle. Fills the kettle with water at the sink. Places the kettle on its base. Presses the kettle switch on. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a mug. Places the mug on the counter. Opens the drawer. Takes out a tea bag. Drops the tea bag into the mug. Waits for the kettle to boil. Pours hot water into the mug. Picks up the mug. Says 'tea break' to Member 2 and Member 6 in the Kitchen. Stands at the counter holding the mug.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading course materials and drafting assignment notes on the computer, checking each reference carefully.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks back to Bedroom 1 with the mug. Sits down at the desk. Places the mug beside the keyboard. Picks up the course reading printout. Reads the first page. Turns to the second page. Picks up the pen. Underlines a passage. Puts the pen down. Moves his hand to the keyboard. Types the assignment heading. Types the first paragraph. Picks up the reading again. Reads a paragraph. Picks up the pen. Writes the reference author and year in the notebook. Opens a second browser tab. Types the reference title. Presses Enter. Reads the reference details on the screen. Copies the citation into the document. Presses Ctrl+S to save. Continues reading and typing. Drinks from the mug.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple flexitarian lunch with vegetables and rice in the rice cooker, eating it and washing up.
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the chair. Picks up the empty mug. Walks from Bedroom 1 to the Kitchen. Places the mug in the sink. Opens the refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Closes the refrigerator. Places the vegetables on the cutting board. Picks up a knife. Chops the vegetables. Picks up the rice. Measures rice into a bowl. Rinses the rice under the tap. Pours the rice into the rice cooker. Adds water. Closes the rice cooker lid. Presses the rice cooker switch on. Picks up the frying pan. Places it on the induction cooker. Presses the induction cooker on. Pours oil into the pan. Adds the vegetables. Stirs with a spatula. Turns off the induction cooker. Opens the rice cooker. Spoons rice onto a plate. Adds the vegetables. Sits at the table with Member 2 and Member 3. Eats the lunch. Drinks water. Stands up. Carries the plate to the sink. Rinses the plate. Washes the pan and spatula with soap. Places them on the drying rack. Wipes the counter with a cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry, running the washing machine and drying clothes, checking the load against his written chore schedule.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen to the Bathroom. Opens the bathroom door. Turns on the bathroom light. Opens the laundry basket. Sorts the clothes into light and dark piles. Picks up the light pile. Opens the washing machine door. Loads the clothes into the drum. Closes the washing machine door. Opens the detergent drawer. Pours detergent into the drawer. Closes the detergent drawer. Presses the washing machine power button. Turns the program dial. Presses the start button. Picks up his written chore schedule from the shelf. Reads the schedule. Puts the schedule back. Waits for the wash cycle. Opens the washing machine door when the cycle ends. Takes out the wet clothes. Places them into the clothes dryer. Closes the dryer door. Presses the dryer power button. Presses the start button. Turns off the bathroom light. Closes the bathroom door. Walks out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking his written reminders and planning the afternoon study blocks in his notebook.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 1. Sits down at the desk. Picks up his written reminder list from the desk. Reads the list. Picks up his notebook. Opens it to a new page. Picks up the pen. Writes '14:00 tutorial' at the top of the page. Writes '15:45 assignment draft' below it. Underlines both lines. Puts the pen down. Places the reminder list back on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Joining an online tutorial discussion group for his social work coursework via the computer.
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at the desk. Moves the mouse to wake the monitor. Clicks the tutorial link in the browser. Clicks the join button. Puts on his headphones. Presses the microphone button to unmute. Says 'hello everyone' to the group. Listens to the tutor. Presses the raise hand button. Waits for his turn. Speaks about his case study notes. Presses the mute button again. Writes notes in his notebook with the pen. Types a comment into the chat box. Presses Enter. Reads the replies on the screen. Nods. Writes more notes. Clicks the leave button when the tutorial ends. Takes off his headphones.

enriched_activities.activity: Making another cup of tea and eating a small snack.
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the chair. Walks from Bedroom 1 to the Kitchen. Picks up the kettle. Fills the kettle with water at the sink. Places the kettle on its base. Presses the kettle switch on. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a mug. Places the mug on the counter. Takes out a tea bag. Drops it into the mug. Opens the snack cupboard. Takes out a packet of biscuits. Opens the packet. Places two biscuits on a small plate. Pours hot water into the mug. Picks up the mug and plate. Sits at the kitchen table. Eats the biscuits. Drinks the tea. Says 'hi' to Member 2 and Member 5 who are also making tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Completing his assignment draft, formatting references and saving backups on his computer.
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the kitchen table. Carries the mug and plate to the sink. Rinses them. Places them on the drying rack. Walks to Bedroom 1. Sits down at the desk. Moves the mouse. Opens the assignment document. Types the remaining paragraphs. Highlights the reference list. Clicks the paragraph format button to set hanging indents. Selects the font size and applies it. Scrolls through the document to check the layout. Clicks the save icon. Presses Ctrl+S. Picks up the USB stick. Plugs the USB stick into the computer. Copies the file onto the USB stick. Waits for the copy to finish. Ejects the USB stick. Unplugs the USB stick. Places it back on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short permitted solo walk around the neighbourhood for exercise during the lockdown.
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the chair. Picks up his jacket. Puts on the jacket. Picks up his phone. Places the phone in his pocket. Picks up his keys. Picks up a face mask. Puts on the face mask. Walks out of Bedroom 1. Walks to the front door. Opens the front door. Steps outside. Closes the front door. Walks along the footpath. Turns left at the corner. Continues walking at a steady pace. Turns around at the end of the street. Walks back along the same route. Reaches the front door. Opens the front door. Steps inside. Closes the front door. Takes off the face mask. Takes off the jacket. Walks back to Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a flexitarian dinner using the induction cooker and oven, keeping the kitchen tidy as he works.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from Bedroom 1 to the Kitchen. Turns on the kitchen light. Opens the refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and tofu. Closes the refrigerator. Places the items on the cutting board. Picks up a knife. Chops the vegetables. Places the chopped vegetables into a bowl. Picks up a pan. Places it on the induction cooker. Presses the induction cooker on. Pours oil into the pan. Adds the vegetables and tofu. Stirs with a spatula. Presses the oven button. Opens the oven door. Places a tray of food inside. Closes the oven door. Sets the oven timer. Wipes the counter with a cloth while the food cooks. Throws the vegetable scraps into the bin. Says 'dinner's almost ready' to Member 3, Member 4, Member 5 and Member 6 in the Kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the table with a cup of tea, without alcohol.
enriched_activities.desc: Turns off the induction cooker. Opens the oven door. Takes out the tray. Places the tray on the counter. Spoons the food onto a plate. Pours hot water into a mug. Drops a tea bag into the mug. Picks up the plate and mug. Sits down at the kitchen table. Eats the dinner. Drinks the tea. Talks with Member 3, Member 4, Member 5 and Member 6 about their study day. Puts down the fork. Picks up the mug. Finishes the tea. Stands up. Picks up the plate and mug.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing the dishes, wiping the counters and putting the dried items away.
enriched_activities.desc: Carries the plate and mug to the sink. Turns on the tap. Picks up the sponge. Adds dish soap to the sponge. Washes the plate. Rinses the plate under the tap. Places the plate on the drying rack. Washes the mug. Rinses the mug. Places the mug on the drying rack. Washes the pan and spatula. Rinses them. Places them on the drying rack. Turns off the tap. Picks up a cloth. Wipes the counter. Wipes the stove top. Opens the cupboard. Picks up the dried plates. Stacks them in the cupboard. Picks up the dried mugs. Places them in the cupboard. Closes the cupboard. Wipes his hands on the cloth. Works alongside Member 4 and Member 5 at the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Sending detailed text messages to his family in China and looking at the photo of his family dog.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen to Bedroom 1. Sits down on the bed. Picks up his phone. Unlocks the phone. Opens the messaging app. Taps the family chat. Types a long message. Presses send. Waits for a reply. Reads the reply on the screen. Types a second message. Presses send. Types a third message about his study day. Presses send. Opens the photo album. Taps the photo of the family dog. Looks at the photo on the screen. Zooms in on the photo. Places the phone down on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading quietly on his bed with a mug of tea to wind down.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from Bedroom 1 to the Kitchen. Picks up the kettle. Fills the kettle with water. Places the kettle on its base. Presses the kettle switch on. Takes out a mug. Drops a tea bag into the mug. Pours hot water into the mug. Picks up the mug. Walks back to Bedroom 1. Sits on the bed. Places the mug on the bedside table. Picks up a book from the bedside table. Opens the book. Reads a page. Turns the page. Reads the next page. Picks up the mug. Drinks the tea. Places the mug back. Continues reading. Turns another page.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking his evening wash, brushing his teeth and getting ready for bed.
enriched_activities.desc: Closes the book. Places it on the bedside table. Stands up. Walks from Bedroom 1 to the Bathroom. Opens the bathroom door. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the tap. Washes his face. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brushes his teeth. Rinses his mouth. Rinses the toothbrush. Places the toothbrush back in the holder. Turns on the shower. Washes his body. Turns off the shower. Steps out. Picks up the towel. Wipes himself dry. Hangs the towel on the hook. Turns off the tap. Turns off the bathroom light. Opens the door. Walks out of the Bathroom. Closes the bathroom door behind him.

enriched_activities.activity: Recording the day's cash spending against his weekly budget and setting tomorrow's reminder alarms on his phone.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 1. Sits down at the desk. Picks up his budget notebook. Opens it to the weekly page. Picks up a pen. Writes today's date in the notebook. Adds the amounts spent on food and transport. Adds the totals with the pen. Writes the remaining weekly balance. Puts the pen down. Picks up the calculator. Presses the number buttons. Reads the total on the screen. Puts the calculator down. Closes the notebook. Picks up his phone. Unlocks it. Opens the alarm app. Sets an alarm for 06:45. Sets a second reminder for his study block. Saves the alarms. Places the phone on the bedside table.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading a book under the desk lamp as a quiet pre-sleep routine.
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up the book from the bedside table. Lies back on the bed. Opens the book. Reads a page. Turns the page. Reads the next page. Turns another page. Adjusts the desk lamp switch to dim the light. Reads another page. Turns the page. Reads to the end of the chapter. Closes the book. Places the book on the bedside table.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the room kept quiet and dark for the night.
enriched_activities.desc: Presses the desk lamp switch off. Lies down on the bed. Pulls the blanket over himself. Closes his eyes. Remains asleep in Bedroom 1. Keeps the room fan switched off. Keeps the room light switched off.
